title: Arguments of a strict gate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $g$ be a gate with a natural-number list of input vertices. Every input vertex of the gate obtained by strictifying $g$ is either the shifted image of an input vertex of $g$, or one of the two vertices $n+1$ and $n+2$.
